quest.title: Big Pudgy Problem!
quest.description: Slimes have suddenly shown up on the mountain behind Springvale, and it seems Timid Morrow has become caught up in the commotion...

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: I may be a hunter by trade, but I've sure met my match with these darned slimes.

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Thanks to them, once again I got nothing to show for this hunt. Ain't caught squat.

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: I sure hope them other hunters ain't as unfortunate as me.

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Speaking of slimes and such... Could you take a look-see around here for me?

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: It could just be my imagination, but... they seem to be showing up more and more 'round this town.

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Can you check the road ahead for slimes? If you see any... you know what to do.

response.speaker: Timid Morrow
response.text: You're doing me a great service. Well, I'd better get back and report all this to Draff.

response.speaker: Timid Morrow
response.text: Here's hoping he isn't so drunk that it goes in one ear and out the other!

choices.text: Sorry, I have to get back.

response.speaker: Timid Morrow
response.text: #Please {M#sir}{F#ma'am}, if not for me, then for the sake of everyone in Springvale.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, what have we here? It looks like dust, but... with elemental traces on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's the last of them. But Paimon wonders what they were doing hanging around here?

talks.objective: Use Anemo to blow out the dust
